title: TaladHub Content Strategy: Building Branding and communicating value through data exchange strategy
image1Description: Creating content to build Branding for the market and TaladHub products

section1.heading: Origin and Intent
section1.content: From the market survey, I found an important Pain Point: many markets have great highlights but lack communication and branding skills to become known. I intended to help in this part by being a 'middleman' connecting markets with consumers. I used Content creation as a medium for Value Exchange to get deep insights into market management, which is essential material for developing TaladHub products to best meet real users' needs.

section2.heading: Role and Action
section2.content: I served as a Content Strategist and Creator to plan communication for both the partner markets and the TaladHub product. This covered everything from Branding design, producing multimedia to promote the highlights of each market, to doing Content Marketing to tell the story of the software we are developing. This helps the target group see how our technology will upgrade their lifestyle in the future.

section3.heading: Challenges
section3.content: The main challenge was changing traditional market stories into modern and interesting content in the digital world while keeping the 'charm and sincerity' of the area. This included managing the limited resources of the markets for the best public relations. I had to learn to be both a Consultant and an Executioner to make the markets see the importance of Branding and accept new technology into their organization.

section4.heading: Results and Learning
section4.content: The result was trust and a strong relationship between the team and market executives, allowing us to receive deep management data and trade secrets to use in software development. This activity taught me that doing a Startup is not just about technology, but about building 'Trust' and giving benefits to others first. This experience helped me develop Branding skills and communication strategies that focus on Win-Win results for everyone.
